job_description:
Fervo Energy's Data & AI team is hiring an Agentic AI Engineer to design and ship agentic workflows that turn unstructured knowledge and structured operational data into autonomous capabilities for engineers, operators, and field decision-makers across drilling, completions, production, geophysics, and power plant operations.

Responsibilities:
- Design and deploy end-to-end agentic AI workflows using planner-worker, orchestrator-executor, multi-agent, and RAG-based architectures.
- Build reusable components and reference patterns for tool routing, state management, error handling, and human-in-the-loop checkpoints.
- Implement robust retrieval pipelines (hybrid search, vector + keyword, graph-aware retrieval) over technical documents, historian data, and operational records.
- Build and maintain a semantic layer over the data lake/warehouse using Snowflake Semantic Views and Databricks Unity Catalog Metric Views.
- Develop knowledge graphs connecting domain entities (wells, pads, assets, equipment, events, documents) to ground LLM reasoning.
- Standardize agent access to enterprise data via Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers.
- Establish agent evaluation frameworks (golden datasets, regression tests, structured evals for accuracy, faithfulness, tool-use correctness) and implement tracing, logging, and cost monitoring.
- Deploy agents as production services on an Azure-native stack (App Service, Container Apps, Functions) with Entra ID SSO and Key Vault-managed secrets; build lightweight UIs (Streamlit, Gradio, or React).

Qualifications:
- Bachelor's or Master's in Computer Engineering or Data Science preferred.
- 2+ years hands-on experience building and deploying agentic AI / LLM-powered applications in production (not just prototypes).
- Strong Python (async, FastAPI, testable production code); experience with a major agent framework; RAG with vector DBs; agent orchestration; MCP familiarity; Azure (or AWS/GCP) deployment; Git/CI-CD; Docker; Terraform; strong observability and production-ops skills.
Pay: $103,152 - $158,588/year, full-time. Benefits include medical, dental, vision, life, disability, flexible PTO, paid parental leave, incentive stock options, bonus program, and 401(k) match.
company_details: Fervo Energy is a next-generation geothermal company building cost-effective, repeatable geothermal power plants to scale clean, always-on energy. Headquartered in Houston, TX, with offices in Golden (CO), Reno (NV), Oakland (CA), and Salt Lake City (UT), Fervo pairs proven oil-and-gas drilling techniques with AI-native operational capabilities.

csv_row.Location: Houston, TX 77002 (910 Louisiana Street) - Hybrid; regular in-office presence required at Houston or Golden, CO office
csv_row.Required Skills: Python (async, FastAPI); agent frameworks (LangChain/LangGraph, LlamaIndex, AutoGen, or Semantic Kernel); LLM APIs/SDKs (Anthropic Claude, OpenAI, Azure OpenAI) with tool use/function calling, structured outputs, streaming, prompt engineering; RAG with vector databases (Azure AI Search, pgvector, Pinecone, Weaviate, Chroma); agent orchestration (multi-step planning, tool routing, state management); Model Context Protocol (MCP); Azure deployment (App Service, Container Apps, Functions, Key Vault, Entra ID); Git and CI/CD; Docker; Terraform; observability/tracing/logging. Preferred: semantic layers (Snowflake Semantic Views, Databricks Metric Views, dbt, Cube, Power BI), knowledge graphs (Neo4j, Cosmos DB Gremlin, RDF/SPARQL), LangSmith, Databricks/Snowflake/ADLS/ADF, oil & gas / energy domain, time-series & industrial IoT (MQTT, OPC UA, SparkplugB), multimodal models.
